name: Maui Wowie Jeeter All In One Diamonds Vape | Pocket Ready | 1g | Sativa
description:
Maui Wowie (not Maui Waui) is a classic sativa with tropical flavors that transport you straight to the shores of Hawaii, where this iconic strain was born. First cultivated in the island’s volcanic soil, Maui Wowie has spread far and wide, known for its sweet pineapple taste and vibrant citrus-earthy aroma. Light and breezy, this strain captures the spirit of island living and pairs perfectly with sunshine, playlists, and a creative headspace.

Ultra clean. Ultra potent. Ultra smooth. Built for our most refined extract, this AIO is made for Liquid Diamonds. With lighter viscosity and higher potency, the hardware is engineered to preserve clarity and deliver smooth, powerful hits without clogging or flooding.
